name: com.trollerbk/mcp
title: TrollerBk
description: TrollerBk MCP: US bankruptcy market intelligence, case search, dockets, documents. Auth required (Bearer, X-API-Key, or ?api_key= / /mcp/t/{token} for header-less clients).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API token from trollerbk.com subscription. Also supports X-API-Key and X-Client-Email. Header-less clients may use ?api_key= or /mcp/t/{token} instead.
